result.summary: The page is largely intact; the main visual problem is poor text contrast in the promotional banner, where light/white text sits on a pale mint background and is hard to read. Horizontally clipped carousel items and bottom-viewport cutoff were treated as expected features per instructions.

issues.description: The promo banner heading '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext with code 'TALLINN3' use very light text on a pale green background, resulting in low contrast and poor legibility.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner text or deepen the background/overlay so the heading, promo code, and conditions meet WCAG contrast guidance.
